goal: Preserve exact pose camera/representation through material workflows and provide aligned line-art/depth pairs.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Agree atomic material IDs, strict pair metadata and the generated asset/provenance contract before parallel edits.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: Root owns reproducible 3D assets and browser QA. Feature owner owns catalog/MCP/validation; workers own viewer/UI and generation/persistence integration.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: One owner per catalog/schema, UI, pipeline and generated asset set. Existing ID-based recipe/history contracts are reused.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: One feature integration owner with two disjoint workers plus root asset generation and independent verification.

assetProvenance.source: Original analytic 3D ellipsoid mannequin, one fixed pose, four camera rotations.
assetProvenance.depth: Nearest positive ray/surface intersection; normalized orthographic camera depth, white-near and black background. Synthetic scene units, not measured human or metric depth.
assetProvenance.reproducibility: python3 scripts/generate-pose-study.py --check passed; all eight PNGs match rerendered output, silhouettes align and foreground depth contains more than 20 levels.
assetProvenance.inspection: Front lineart/depth, profile lineart and back depth visually inspected.

coverage: Six theme/viewport paired-comparison cases with keyboard range and aligned image bounds
Exact back-depth PNG bytes in the mocked provider request and history replay
MCP exact material ID, alternatives, representation and v1 recipe link
Manual prompt preservation while switching selected variants

verification.assetRegeneration: python3 scripts/generate-pose-study.py --check passed after final code changes.
verification.independentReview: Found and fixed cached-image loading state when switching depth comparison to lineart; unit and production browser regression added. No other confirmed defects.
visualInspection: Front lineart/depth and profile lineart/back depth asset renders

implementation.catalog: 16 materials total; original 8 IDs preserved and 8 new IDs encode one of four actual camera views plus lineart/depth.
implementation.persistence: Existing v1 recipes, baskets, drafts and history store exact atomic material IDs; original PNG bytes retained.
implementation.inspection: View/representation selectors and aligned keyboard-accessible comparison slider; no controls for missing alternatives.
implementation.prompts: Single-view structural guidance distinguishes lineart from normalized synthetic depth; manual text preserved.
implementation.mcp: Strict view/representation filters, exact alternatives and paired links; composed recipe preserves chosen ID.

limitations: The pilot contains one synthetic mannequin pose with four camera views; existing unpaired drawings do not gain invented views or depth.
Depth values are relative scene depth, not measured human depth or physical distances.
Comparison is an inspection operation; one selected pose representation is sent to generation.
Node build checks identities, hashes, image dimensions and camera consistency. Explicit Python rerender proves reproducible geometry/output.
